SEARCH
Package org.aeonbits.owner

Interface Config

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
Accessible, Mutable, Reloadable, Traceable
public interface Config extends Serializable
Marker interface that must be implemented by all Config sub-interfaces.

Sub-interfaces may also extend Accessible to allow some debugging facility, or Reloadable to allow the user to programmatically reload properties.

A method whose return type is another interface extending this one reads the section of the configuration below its own key, as a configuration object of its own: ServerConfig server() resolves server.host and server.port. A List or an array of them reads servers[0].host, a Map of them reads servers.alpha.host, and a method taking arguments asks for one by name. There is no annotation for any of this: the return type is the whole of the declaration. See Config.Prefix for how the keys compose, and the documentation for the rest.

Author:
Luigi R. Viggiano
